mapper.select: SELECT w.stock_code AS symbol, c.company_name AS name, c.market_type AS market, w.created_at FROM watchlist w JOIN company c ON c.stock_code = w.stock_code WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.created_at, w.stock_code
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO watchlist (user_id, stock_code) VALUES (#{userId}, #{symbol})
